messages.text: Friday, November 20 · Canton, Michigan
Clear skies and one light-day of distance for a lonely voyager

The air remains unseasonably warm today as we clear a path toward the weekend. Our local horizon is quiet, while far beyond it, a human-made vessel reaches a staggering new milestone in the deep void.
Expect a clear, mild day with a high near 65 degrees and a low around 40 degrees.
The sun rises at 7:31 AM and sets at 5:08 PM, while the moon is currently in a waxing gibbous phase at 76.7 percent illumination.
A quiet Thursday
With no public events scheduled locally today, it is a fine afternoon to enjoy the unseasonable warmth at one of our neighborhood parks.
Local students have the Girls Gear Up outreach event tomorrow morning at 7:30 AM.
Lansing shifts as Canton leadership rises

Incoming House Speaker Ranjeev Puri of Canton will lead a Michigan Legislature featuring a growing progressive caucus in 2027. This group is expected to advocate for corporate tax increases and government ethics reforms.
Looking toward the weekend

Ann Arbor hosts the Musket musical production of West Side Story at North Quad tomorrow at 7:00 PM. For those seeking comedy, Last Call Improv offers a free show in Hamtramck on December 3 at 9:00 PM.

Saturday, November 21 · Canton, Michigan
Morning fog, a light-day of distance, and the shift in Lansing

A thick blanket of fog gives way to a mild, sixty-degree day in Canton. We look today at the shifting political landscape in the state capitol and the immense distance Voyager 1 has traveled into the dark.
Expect fog throughout the day with a high near 62 degrees and a low of 37 degrees.
The sun rises at 7:32 AM and sets at 5:07 PM, with a waxing gibbous moon that is 85.1 percent illuminated.
A quiet Friday in the mist
With no local public events on the calendar for today, it is a morning to enjoy the stillness or attend the Girls Gear Up outreach event at 7:30 AM.
Mark your calendar for the 862 meeting coming up on November 25 at 6:30 PM.
New legislative tides in Lansing

Incoming House Speaker Ranjeev Puri of Canton will lead a legislature featuring a growing progressive caucus in 2027. This group is expected to advocate for corporate tax increases and government ethics reforms.
Weekend options in Ann Arbor
Consider the lecture on the history of the G bugle at the Earl V. Moore Building tomorrow at 5:00 PM or the staged reading of The Boy at the Edge of Everything at the Keene Theater at 7:00 PM.
